subject: Just in time: seeking mentors for hastening phylogenetics algotithms with CUDA

messages.author: c90c44fca75558cd
messages.subject: Just in time: seeking mentors for hastening phylogenetics algotithms with CUDA
parts:
Hello there!

I'm a Computer Science masters degree studant that use to research massively parallel algorithms at the HPC research group of my university (more information here). The subject of my undergraduate term paper was "CUDA programming for Comparative Phylogenetics", wich in turn yelds the development of a parallel version of the software SUNPLIN. The original version of SUNPLIN is known as the fastest sequential algorithm for computation of patristic distances, a very time-consuming operation. In other hand, the parallel version of it is able to speedup the execution by up to 74 times in comparsion to the sequencial version, acording to the first benchmarks.

The parallel version of SUNPLIN is a C++/CUDA standalone application, for performance purposes. This fact can prevent the use of most users wich are mainly R users and therefore accustomed to its facilities. My aim is to build a convenient R package that wraps SUNPLIN calls to GPU, is CRAN compliant and is easily installable and manageable.

Hope there's some Interested ones out there!

Is a pleasure to meet you guys, 

Evandro Carrijo Taquary
Federal University of Goiás
